title: Who Else Was Waiting?
summaryZh: 哈金開著自己的車來到那棟綠色房子前。他以為這趟是為了道別,結果調度員在刷卡紀錄裡找到了另一件他完全不知道的事。

daily.seriesTitle: Two Minutes on the North Road

sentences.text: On Saturday morning, Hakim drove his own car out to the north road.
sentences.zh: 星期六早上,哈金開著自己的車來到北路。

sentences.text: The green house looked much smaller than it did from the driver's seat of a bus.
sentences.zh: 從公車駕駛座上看過去的那棟綠色房子,現在看起來小多了。

sentences.text: He knocked twice on the iron gate and then waited on the pavement.
sentences.zh: 他在鐵門上敲了兩下,然後站在人行道上等。

sentences.text: A young woman opened an upstairs window and looked down at him.
sentences.zh: 一位年輕女子打開樓上的窗戶,低頭看著他。

sentences.text: "You are the bus driver," she said. "My mother talked about you."
sentences.zh: 「你就是那位公車司機,」她說。「我媽提過你。」

sentences.text: Her name was Bisi, and she had come to empty the house.
sentences.zh: 她叫比西,是回來把房子清空的。

sentences.text: Mrs. Oyelaran had moved to her daughter's town in the south three weeks before.
sentences.zh: 歐耶拉蘭太太三個星期前搬到南邊女兒住的鎮上了。

sentences.text: She was well, Bisi said, and she was already complaining about the buses there.
sentences.zh: 比西說她很好,而且已經開始抱怨那裡的公車了。

sentences.text: Hakim laughed, and then he felt the laugh stop somewhere in his chest.
sentences.zh: 哈金笑了,接著又覺得那個笑卡在胸口某個地方。

sentences.text: On Monday the dispatcher was waiting for him in the yard.
sentences.zh: 星期一,調度員在車場等他。

sentences.text: He told her that the old woman was safe, and that the house was empty now.
sentences.zh: 他告訴她,那位老太太平安,房子現在也空了。

sentences.text: "Then the two minutes are finished," he said, and he heard how flat it sounded.
sentences.zh: 「那兩分鐘就到此為止了,」他說,自己也聽見那句話有多平淡。

sentences.text: The dispatcher did not answer him straight away.
sentences.zh: 調度員沒有立刻回答他。

sentences.text: She had spent the whole weekend reading the card data for stop three.
sentences.zh: 她整個週末都在看第三站的刷卡紀錄。

sentences.text: Somebody else was tapping a card there at almost exactly the same time.
sentences.zh: 有另一個人幾乎在同一個時間也在那裡刷卡。

sentences.text: The same card, five mornings a week, for the last two years.
sentences.zh: 同一張卡片,一週五個早上,已經持續兩年了。

sentences.text: It belonged to a man named Tomas, who Hakim had never once spoken to.
sentences.zh: 那張卡的主人叫托瑪斯,哈金從來沒有跟他說過話。

sentences.text: He was quiet, he sat near the back, and he always looked tired.
sentences.zh: 他很安靜,總是坐在後面,而且看起來永遠很累。

sentences.text: Tomas worked the night shift at the packing plant behind the third stop.
sentences.zh: 托瑪斯在第三站後面那間包裝廠上夜班。

sentences.text: His shift ended at six fifty-eight, and the bus was due to leave at seven.
sentences.zh: 他的班六點五十八分結束,公車預定七點開走。

sentences.text: For two years he had run out of that gate and caught the bus by seconds.
sentences.zh: 兩年來,他每天衝出廠門,總是差幾秒鐘趕上車。

sentences.text: He had never once known that the bus was not really waiting for him.
sentences.zh: 他從來不知道,那班公車其實不是在等他。

sentences.text: He had always believed that he was simply fast enough.
sentences.zh: 他一直以為,是自己跑得夠快。

sentences.text: "If you had left on time," the dispatcher said, "he would have missed it every day."
sentences.zh: 「如果你每天都準時開走,」調度員說,「他每天都會錯過。」

sentences.text: Hakim thought about two years of mornings that he had not noticed at all.
sentences.zh: 哈金想著那兩年來,自己完全沒有察覺的每一個早晨。

sentences.text: He had been waiting for one person and quietly carrying another.
sentences.zh: 他等的是一個人,卻在不知不覺中載著另一個人。

sentences.text: Two minutes had been holding up a life he knew nothing about.
sentences.zh: 那兩分鐘一直撐著一段他一無所知的人生。

sentences.text: The dispatcher took the timetable to the planning office that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午,調度員把時刻表帶到規劃辦公室。

sentences.text: She did not ask them to forgive the two minutes.
sentences.zh: 她沒有請他們原諒那兩分鐘。

sentences.text: She asked them to print the two minutes into the schedule itself.
sentences.zh: 她請他們把那兩分鐘直接印進時刻表裡。

sentences.text: It took four weeks, and in the end they agreed to try it for a season.
sentences.zh: 這件事花了四個星期,最後他們同意先試行一季。

sentences.text: Stop three is now written down as a two-minute stop on the north road.
sentences.zh: 現在第三站在北路的時刻表上,正式寫成一個兩分鐘的停靠站。

sentences.text: Hakim's screen is green every morning, and it tells him nothing he needs.
sentences.zh: 哈金的螢幕每天早上都是綠的,而那上面沒有任何他需要的東西。

sentences.text: He still opens the door and counts, exactly as he did before.
sentences.zh: 他還是打開車門開始數,跟以前一模一樣。

sentences.text: One morning Tomas came to the front of the bus before getting off.
sentences.zh: 有天早上,托瑪斯下車前走到了車頭。

sentences.text: "Somebody told me about the counting," he said. "I never knew."
sentences.zh: 「有人跟我說了數數的事,」他說。「我一直都不知道。」

sentences.text: "Neither did I," Hakim said. "Not really."
sentences.zh: 「我也不知道,」哈金說。「其實我也不知道。」

sentences.text: Then he closed the door and drove on toward the hills.
sentences.zh: 然後他關上車門,繼續往山的方向開去。

questions.q: Why had Mrs. Oyelaran stopped taking the number nine bus?
options: She had moved south to live in her daughter's town
She had decided the bus was too often late
She had started walking to the town square instead

questions.q: What did the card data from stop three reveal?
options: Another passenger had depended on the two minutes for two years
Nobody had used stop three since Mrs. Oyelaran left
Tomas had been paying for the wrong kind of ticket

questions.q: What does the dispatcher's request to the planning office show about her?
options: She wanted the schedule to match what the route really needed
She wanted to prove that Hakim had broken the rules
She wanted the punctuality screens taken out of the buses
